authority: 用户本轮授权由本代理落实接入契约并依K1到K7制作；不修改生产代码，不把契约写成已接入

encounter_api.path: PackedVector2Array authoritative closed centerline in world pixels

C1.boss_center_policy: spawn near player by existing Game._point_around; do not teleport player or force travel to landmark
C1.serpent_path_policy: rounded rectangle inside Game.bounds inset96; start with intersection of player-centered 2048-square and inset bounds, min corner radius128; contraction inset<=128; head/tail follow arc-length path; path is also body contact source
C1.arena_radii_note: K0 R1024/R640 were diagram fixtures, not production collision constants. All Fx consume supplied geometry, never infer radius from bitmap.

C2.loop_policy: idle/move and listed environmental loops only
C2.timeline: non-loop animations clamp last frame; gameplay emits release/contact/phase events; no damage from animation_finished
C2.windup: 3 frames at8fps then hold until release event; no duplicate frames added to make waiting time
C2.old_boss_compatibility: override fps only on K actors; do not change prior Boss._ready global8fps behavior

body.renderer: continuous arc-length UV ribbon; no whole-snake atlas

C3.targeting: one Enemy/Boss spatial-index entry for head only; ribbon contact is geometry query with its own hit cooldown

fenrir.maw_contract: upper_socket/lower_socket/tip direction supplied by state; fatal_shape and attract_shape shared by drawing and damage; body never stretched
fenrir.escape: windup and escape phase precede fatal event; presentation cannot commit fatal hit; player damage/revive API keeps its normal ownership
fenrir.binding_status: start/end event; pickup consumes once; controller supplies binding duration and damage multiplier

C4.phase_policy: each threshold triggers once per encounter
C4.clip_contract: sword sector, firewall region and unsafe_cell_set sent as authoritative geometry; safe runes and fire read identical set
C4.firewall_axes: x tangent, y negative outside/fire; inner side transparent

C5.rules: new special behavior scoped to those ids; no common-enemy AI edits from asset production; dead assets unchanged

fate_conditions.vidar_intervened: player.faith.has(odin) && player.gods[odin].awakened, once during Fenrir fight
fate_conditions.freyr_assisted: player.faith.has(freyja) && player.gods[freyja].awakened, once during Surtr fight

periodic_aid_api.visuals: reuse existing god effect library for all eight ids; no eight new character sets
periodic_aid_api.timing: external gameplay controller supplies nearby eligibility and cadence; bitmap playback never invents bonus damage

C6.presentation: Vidar hand/boot sockets bind to wolf upper/lower jaw sockets. Freyr heal flash only after actual grant event.

C7.edge_alpha: binary mask, existing shared Vigrid terrain palette
C7.border: existing scorched terrain + existing props + reused fire strip + program haze; not eight new border PNGs

C8.audio_trigger_contract: event_id deduplicated per cast/phase; use existing Audio 24 voices, MIN_GAP=.05 and MAX_SAME=4; never one voice per grid cell
C8.optional_ambience: omitted in v1; use dedicated music and sparse existing fire events, no unbounded ambient loop
C8.sfx_format: PCM16 WAV mono44100, about -1dBFS peak, onset<=10ms; high frequency groups3 distinct variants<=.3s
C8.music: vigrid.ogg Vorbis stereo44100 about -16LUFS, complete musical phrases; duration chosen from licensed source phrase, three-loop listening required
C8.ending: five skippable text beats using existing UI, no new ending illustrations
C8.release_gate: asset check / listening / controlled runtime / full playthrough statuses recorded independently
